summary: Platform-specific native binary package with no observed harmful behavior
details: Package @k18k/entrypoint-sdk-darwin-x64@0.2.1 is a darwin-x64 platform-specific sub-package, following the standard npm pattern for distributing prebuilt native binaries per OS/architecture (optionalDependencies selected by the parent SDK package based on process.platform/process.arch). The tarball contains a small number of files and no install, preinstall, postinstall, or prepare lifecycle scripts were observed. No network calls, no reads of installer secrets (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, environment variables), no fetch-and-execute, no silent-relay, and no persistence behavior were observed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
